newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvia reinvites bids for leading bus company.
newsitem.headline: Latvia reinvites bids for leading bus company.

text.p: The Latvian Privatisation Agency (LPA) on Monday said it was inviting bids again for the privatisation of the largest bus company in Latvia, Nordeka, with applications to be receied by February 15 next year.
This time the state would not demand 51 percent of the stock as was the case in May, LPA said in a statement.
Nordeka, a leading intercity and long distance bus operator, with about 30 percent of the Latvian market, had a turnover of 1.4 million lats in 1996.
The company operates eight international routes to the Baltic, Belarussian and Polish capitals as well the central bus station in the centre of the Latvian capital Riga.
The major block of shares will be sold to a strategic investor, LPA statement says, adding that the amount will be determined after all proposals are evaluated by the Agency.
